mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as tendereeName, c1.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, c2.C_Name as secAgencyName, c2.C_Abbreviation as secAgencyAbbName, dp.D_Name as secContractingDepartmentName, (select count(*) from Sec_Bidding_Plan_Change bpc left join Sec_Info_Change sc on sc.Bpc_Id=bpc.Bpc_Id where sc.Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id and sc.Sec_Change_Type='变更' and bpc.State!=3 and bpc.State!=7 and sc.Bpc_Id!=#{bpcId}) as unalterable, sec.* from Sec_Info_Change sec left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_ID=sec.Sec_Agency left join SYS_Department dp on dp.D_ID=sec.Sec_Contracting_Department where sec.Bpc_Id=#{bpcId}
